info.title: ERP Purchasing Microservice (Procure-to-Pay / P2P)
info.description: Enterprise-grade Procure-to-Pay microservice implementing end-to-end procurement workflows: Purchase Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), 3-Way Matching Vendor Bills, Purchase Returns (RTV) with Debit Notes, RFQ Multi-Vendor Sourcing, and Real-time Vendor Performance Analytics.
